answer: The most convincing sybil defense is a time-locked honesty deposit: an agent must lock a stake before joining; it is refunded only after several clean epochs, and cheating triggers slashing. So a fake identity cannot exist without idle capital parked for the whole epoch window, lost on detection. Each sybil costs the attacker a locked deposit that earns nothing and can vanish at any audit. Like timber pilings in a riverbed, each identity is anchored by collateral, while stakeless sybils drift like a zephyr, since voting weight follows deposits.
